title: MultiCryptoBOT
tagline: Discord MultiCrypto Bot  - An experimental integration  of ETH APIs
description: An experimental integration  of ETHOnline Sponsors API and Discord.js This bot integrates 0x protocol(liquidity aggregator enabling the future of DeFi ) API , ParaSwap(the fastest DEX aggregator) API, Pocket ( data marketplace for web3 applications that leverages cost-efficient tokenomics) and Skynet API.
